items.a: Always with the operator. JetMarket is a marketplace, not a broker — we match requests to operators and take a success fee from them when a deal closes.

items.q: What does it cost me as a buyer?
items.a: Nothing. Requesting quotes is free; operators pay the platform.
A repositioning flight an aircraft flies anyway — sold at a deep discount when it matches your route.
Operators self-declare their fleet and credentials; our team verifies documentation manually. Unverified operators are marked and receive RFQs with a delay.

items.q: Can I buy an aircraft here?
items.a: Yes — aircraft_sale listings accept RFQs like any other; success fee on closed sales is 1.5%.

sections.body: {entity} operates a marketplace platform connecting buyers of aviation services with independent operators. {entity} is not a broker, not an air carrier and not an operator. Contracts for transport or sale are concluded directly between buyer and operator.
Operator accounts self-declare fleet, credentials and regulatory status. Verification is a manual documentation review; an unverified badge is displayed until completed.
Buyers use the platform free of charge. Operators pay a subscription and a success fee on closed deals as published on the pricing section.
No scraping, no bypassing the RFQ flow to avoid fees, no unlawful listings. We may suspend accounts for abuse.
To the maximum extent permitted by law, {entity} is not liable for operator performance, aircraft condition, or deal outcomes. Statutory liability remains unaffected.
Contact details submitted in RFQs, account data for operators, and standard technical logs.
To route requests to operators, deliver quotes, run billing, and prevent abuse. We do not sell personal data.
Data is kept for the life of the account plus legal retention windows. Contact {email} for access, correction or deletion.
